== Biography ==

The Duchess is a personage of Wonderland known chiefly through others' regard. The White Rabbit fears her temper should he keep her waiting. When encountered during a walk through the croquet ground, she was found in pleasant spirits, though inclined to seek moral lessons in all about her. The Queen's threat of execution marks her precarious standing.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Alice]]''' — acquaintance. The two encountered one another in the Duchess's kitchen and again in Wonderland.

'''[[Queen]]''' — acquaintance. Their connection is not clearly established.

'''[[White Rabbit]]''' — employment. The Rabbit appears anxious about keeping the Duchess waiting, suggesting he may serve her.
